title: Citibank Slapped With a $6,391,119 Fine Over Payments That Breached Sanctions on Russia
summary:
Britain's financial sanctions office penalized Citibank's London branch £4.73 million for processing 970 payments worth £19.7 million that made funds available to designated Russian entities. Most breaches occurred in 2022 after the invasion of Ukraine, with no intent found but significant operational failings cited.
The post Citibank Slapped With a $6,391,119 Fine Over Payments That Breached Sanctions on Russia appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Britain's financial sanctions office has penalized Citibank's London branch millions of dollars for processing hundreds of payments that breached sanctions on Russia. The regulatory action followed operational failings that allowed funds to be made available to designated Russian entities, predominantly after the invasion of Ukraine in 2022, though investigators found no intentional wrongdoing by the bank.
